summary: Additive icon layer on the existing semantic-type system, with no new framework, dependency or build-output change. A new internal module, UI/zestIcons.tsx, owns the 47 built-in names' path data and a module-level map of React SVG elements that are created once at import (aliases deliberately share one element). A new public component, UI/ZestIcon.tsx, looks a name up in O(1), renders the shared element unchanged, hides it from screen readers (aria-hidden + focusable=false) and returns null for unknown names; an optional size and className are applied by a thin wrapper so the shared SVG element is never cloned or rebuilt. UI/semanticTypeButtonConfigDefaults.tsx drops every react-icons/fa import and uses those shared elements as iconLeft (or iconRight for view, details and next) for the existing entries, keeping their order and every option they have today; confirm gains the standard check icon because R3 requires an icon on every built-in type. The same file appends exactly the 28 new entries with the R2 defaults: standard solid variant and iconLeft for search, filter, sort, copy, paste, home, menu, more, settings, help, info, favorite, attach, lock, unlock, undo, redo; back uses iconLeft, next iconRight; approve is success, reject and warning are danger; send, login, logout, export, import, approve, reject and archive get only busyOptions.minBusyDurationMs = 500 (no successOptions, no confirmOptions). UI/ZestButton.tsx only widens the SemanticType union from 19 to 47 names. UI/index.ts adds the ZestIcon, ZestIconProps and ZestIconSize exports. Existing CSS Modules, the styles.icon slot, currentColor theming and the existing useZestConfig precedence/deep-merge are reused; one .zestIcon rule is added for size in em (font sizes are already rem based). No change to useZestConfig, react-icons (FaSpinner and the dropdown chevron stay), rollup, peer or runtime dependencies, or the dist layout. Public surface: added ZestIcon/ZestIconProps/ZestIconSize; extended SemanticType; no existing export, prop or type removed or renamed. Release: package.json and package-lock.json go to 1.7.0 and documentation/breaking-changes.md gets a 1.7.0 entry for the new icon art. Scale/cost: the number of built-in types is fixed at 47, lookup is a single object property read, the 47 SVG elements and their path strings are allocated once at module load (a few KB), and per button, per render the work is constant; 100x more buttons only adds the unavoidable DOM nodes, with no loops over the type list, no caches that grow, no timers, listeners, network or storage. Drawing set: search magnifier, filter funnel, sort up/down arrows, copy two sheets, paste clipboard, back arrow-left, next arrow-right, home house, menu three lines, more three dots, settings gear, help question circle, info info circle, warning triangle, send paper plane, login arrow into a door, logout arrow out of a door, undo/redo curved arrows, approve check circle, reject x circle, favorite heart, attach paperclip, lock/unlock padlock, archive box, export/import arrow out of/into a box.

touches: UI/ZestButton.tsx — widen the SemanticType union with the 28 new names; icon-rendering, busy/success/fail, confirmation, toggle and dropdown logic stay byte-for-byte unchanged

UI/index.ts — add the public ZestIcon/ZestIconProps/ZestIconSize exports
Styles/ZestButton.module.css — add .zestIcon (1em box, currentColor already inherited) plus the optional ZestIcon size classes/wrapper; no existing rule changes
package.json and package-lock.json — raise 1.6.1 to 1.7.0; dependencies and peerDependencies untouched
README.md and documentation/{features,api,examples,configuration,development,breaking-changes}.md — document the 47 types, ZestIcon, defaults and the icon-art note, keeping previous/next links
Existing tests that assert icon markup or the semantic defaults map — characterization coverage extended without changing behavioural expectations
